bullets.text: Samsung Expands Refurbished Program - **Samsung**'s Certified Re-Newed program now available in the **UK**, France, and Germany.
Musk Seeks Massive Damages - **Elon Musk** claims **OpenAI** defrauded him, demanding up to $134 billion in damages.
Runpod Hits $120M ARR - **Runpod**, an AI app hosting platform, achieves significant revenue growth in just four years.
Visible Offers Outage Credits - **Visible**, owned by **Verizon**, provides $5 credits to customers after a service outage.
YouTube Eases Monetization Rules - **YouTube** relaxes guidelines, allowing more controversial content to earn full ad revenue.
TikTok Launches PineDrama App - **TikTok** introduces PineDrama, a standalone app for short drama series.
Google Appeals Monopoly Ruling - **Google** contests a court ruling declaring it an illegal online search monopolist.
ChatGPT to Feature Ads - **OpenAI** plans to introduce targeted ads for certain **ChatGPT** users to generate revenue.
ClickHouse Valuation Soars - **ClickHouse**, a database provider, reaches a $15 billion valuation after a $400 million funding round.
